annotations.title: Ad platforms a conversion goes to

description: The ad platform conversions APIs send_conversion_event sends to, per brand. action list (default) shows them plus what each platform needs; add saves one: platform (meta, tiktok, linkedin, snapchat, reddit, pinterest, x, microsoft, chatgpt, applovin, amazon, google_ads, taboola, outbrain, trade_desk, attentive, impact, awin, campaign_manager, klaviyo, google_analytics) with its ids (Taboola taboolaAccountId; Outbrain outbrainMarketerId; The Trade Desk trackerId + advertiserId; Impact programId + eventTypeId; Awin advertiserId (default: the connected one); Campaign Manager 360 floodlightConfigurationId + floodlightActivityId; Google Analytics measurementId + apiSecret, stored encrypted; Attentive, Impact, Awin and Klaviyo send on their connector key; Meta pixelId + adAccountId; TikTok eventSourceId = the pixel CODE, eventSource web/offline/crm, advertiserId; LinkedIn conversionId of a Conversions API rule; Snapchat pixelId; Reddit pixelId; Pinterest adAccountId; X pixelId and eventId; Microsoft conversionName of an OFFLINE goal; ChatGPT Ads pixelSnippetId + apiKey, the Conversions API key, stored encrypted and never shown again; Amazon amazonProfileId + countryCode). eventNames limits which events it takes (LinkedIn, Microsoft, Google Ads, Impact and Campaign Manager 360 need it: their rule, goal, action, event type or Floodlight activity decides the type); eventMap renames one of yours to the platform’s, e.g. {"QualifiedLead":"CUSTOM_EVENT_1"}. Meta pixels, Amazon profiles and LinkedIn rules are checked against the brand’s own account when added; the rest on the first send. action remove takes destinationId. Free.

adAccountId.description: the ad account, where the platform has several shared

apiSecret.description: Google Analytics Measurement Protocol secret, stored encrypted

eventMap.description: your event name to this platform’s event name

eventNames.description: the events this destination takes; omit for every event

eventSourceId.description: TikTok pixel code, offline or CRM event set id

measurementId.description: Google Analytics web stream G- id

pixelId.description: Meta / Snapchat / Reddit / X pixel id

platform.description: add: meta, tiktok, linkedin, snapchat, reddit, pinterest, x, microsoft, chatgpt, applovin, amazon, google_ads, taboola, outbrain, trade_desk, attentive, impact, awin, campaign_manager, klaviyo or google_analytics

trackerId.description: Trade Desk Real-Time Conversion tracking tag id (with advertiserId)
